business_summary: Enpro Inc., an industrial technology company, design, develops, manufactures, and markets proprietary, value-added products and solutions to safeguard critical environments in the United States, Europe, Asia Pacific, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Sealing Technologies and Advanced Surface Technologies. The Sealing Technologies segment offers single-use hygienic seals, tubing, components and assemblies for food and pharma markets; metallic, non-metallic and composite material gaskets; dynamic seals; compression packing; elastomeric components; custom-engineered mechanical seals; hydraulic components; expansion joints; and wall penetration products for chemical and petrochemical processing, nuclear energy, hydrogen, natural gas, food and biopharmaceutical processing, primary metal manufacturing, mining, water and waste treatment, commercial vehicle, aerospace, medical, filtration, and semiconductor fabrication industries. It offers its products under the Garlock, Gylon, Blue-Gard, ONE-UP, Bio-Pro, Tuf-Steel, Detectomer, and LINK-SEAL brand name. The Advanced Surface Technologies segment offers engineering, manufacturing and precision machining of complex front-end wafer processing sub-systems; cleaning, coating, testing, refurbishment, and verification services for critical components and assemblies used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment; optical filters and proprietary thin-film coatings for applications in the industrial technology, life sciences, and semiconductor markets; optical filters and thin-film coatings for applications in the industrial technology, life sciences, and semiconductor markets; and edge-welded metal bellows for the semiconductor equipment industry and applications in the space, aerospace, and defense markets. The company was formerly known as EnPro Industries, Inc. and changed its name to Enpro Inc. in December 2023. Enpro Inc. was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina.
business_summary_ko: 산업 기술 회사인 Enpro Inc.는 미국, 유럽, 아시아 태평양 및 국제적으로 중요한 환경을 보호하기 위한 독점적인 부가가치 제품 및 솔루션을 설계, 개발, 제조 및 판매합니다. 씰링 기술(Sealing Technologies)과 고급 표면 기술(Advanced Surface Technologies)이라는 두 부문으로 운영됩니다. Sealing Technologies 부문은 식품 및 제약 시장을 위한 일회용 위생 씰, 튜브, 부품 및 어셈블리를 제공합니다. 금속, 비금속 및 복합 재료 개스킷; 동적 씰; 압축 포장; 탄성 구성 요소; 맞춤형 기계적 밀봉; 유압 부품; 확장 조인트; 화학 및 석유화학 처리, 원자력, 수소, 천연가스, 식품 및 생물약제 처리, 1차 금속 제조, 광업, 물 및 폐기물 처리, 상업용 차량, 항공우주, 의료, 여과 및 반도체 제조 산업을 위한 벽 관통 제품 등이 있습니다. Garlock, Gylon, Blue-Gard, ONE-UP, Bio-Pro, Tuf-Steel, Detectomer 및 LINK-SEAL 브랜드 이름으로 제품을 제공합니다. Advanced Surface Technologies 부문은 복잡한 프런트 엔드의 엔지니어링, 제조 및 정밀 가공을 제공합니다.
